data.name: Govind
data.gender_notes: Govind is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit go, 'cow', + vind, 'to find, obtain' — 'protector of cows'. Its root is Sanskrit go + vind. An epithet of Krishna. Govind is a Sanskrit name meaning “Cowherd; protector of cows; Krishna”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Govind expresses “Cowherd; protector of cows; Krishna”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit go, 'cow', + vind, 'to find, obtain' — 'protector of cows'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Govind total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
